title: A novel iheyamine A derivative L42 suppresses acute myeloid leukemia via dual regulation of the PI3K/AKT/FOXO3a axis and TNF signaling pathway.
authors: Dinghuan, Wang; Yi, Kuang; Jianzhi, Tian; Wenfei, Wei; Chunlin, Wang; Anling, Hu; Zhixu, He; Ben-David, Yaacov; Sheng, Liu; Xiaoyan, Yang; Xiao, Xiao
one_liner_zh: 该文研究化合物L42通过PI3K/AKT/FOXO3a和TNF通路抑制急性髓系白血病，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Acute myeloid leukemia (AML) is one of the most common hematopoietic malignancies and the development of new drugs is crucial for the treatment of this lethal disease. Iheyamine A is a nonmonoterpenoid azepinoindole alkaloid from the ascidian Polycitorella sp., and its anticancer mechanism has not been investigated in leukemias. Herein, we showed the significant antileukemic activity of L42 in AML cell lines HEL, HL-60 and THP-1. The IC(50) values were 0.466+/-0.099 microM, 0.356+/-0.023 microM, 0.475+/-0.084 microM in the HEL, HL-60 and THP-1 cell lines, respectively, which were lower than the IC(50) (2.594+/-0.271 microM) in the normal liver cell line HL-7702. Furthermore, L42 significantly inhibited the growth of peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) from an AML patient. In vivo, L42 effectively suppressed leukemia progression in a mouse model induced by Friend murine leukemia virus (F-MuLV). Mechanistically, we showed that L42 induced cell cycle arrest and apoptosis in leukemia cell lines. RNA sequencing analysis of L42-treated THP-1 cells revealed that the differentially expressed genes (DEGs) were enriched in the cell cycle and apoptosis and predominantly enriched in the PI3K/AKT pathway. Accordingly, L42 decreased the expression of the phospho-PI3K (p85), phospho-AKT and phospho-FOXO3a. Docking and CETSA analysis indicated that L42 bound to the PI3K isoform p110alpha (PIK3CA), which was implicated in the suppression of the PI3K/AKT pathway. L42 was also shown to initiate the TNF signaling-mediated apoptosis. Moreover, L42 exhibited stronger anti-leukemia activity and sensitivity in IDH2-mutant HEL cells than in IDH2-wild-type control. In conclusion, L42 effectively suppresses cell proliferation and triggers apoptosis in AML cell lines in part through inhibition of the PI3K/AKT signaling pathway to restore FOXO3a expression and activation of the TNF signaling pathway. Thus, the iheyamine A derivative L42 represents a novel candidate for AML therapy.
abstract_zh: 急性髓系白血病（acute myeloid leukemia, AML）是最常见的造血系统恶性肿瘤之一，开发新药对于治疗这种致命疾病至关重要。Iheyamine A是一种来自海鞘Polycitorella sp.的非单萜吲哚并氮杂环生物碱，其在白血病中的抗癌机制尚未被研究。在此，我们展示了L42在AML细胞系HEL、HL-60和THP-1中显著的抗白血病活性。在HEL、HL-60和THP-1细胞系中，IC(50)值分别为0.466±0.099 μM、0.356±0.023 μM和0.475±0.084 μM，低于正常肝细胞系HL-7702中的IC(50)值（2.594±0.271 μM）。此外，L42显著抑制了来自AML患者外周血单个核细胞（peripheral blood mononuclear cells, PBMCs）的生长。在体内，L42有效抑制了由Friend鼠白血病病毒（Friend murine leukemia virus, F-MuLV）诱导的小鼠模型中的白血病进展。在机制上，我们显示L42诱导白血病细胞系中的细胞周期阻滞和凋亡。对L42处理的THP-1细胞进行的RNA测序分析显示，差异表达基因（differentially expressed genes, DEGs）富集于细胞周期和凋亡相关通路，并主要富集于PI3K/AKT通路。相应地，L42降低了磷酸化PI3K（p85）、磷酸化AKT和磷酸化FOXO3a的表达。对接和CETSA分析表明，L42与PI3K亚型p110α（PIK3CA）结合，这与PI3K/AKT通路的抑制有关。L42还被证明能启动TNF信号介导的凋亡。此外，L42在IDH2突变的HEL细胞中表现出比IDH2野生型对照更强的抗白血病活性和敏感性。总之，L42通过部分抑制PI3K/AKT信号通路以恢复FOXO3a表达并激活TNF信号通路，有效抑制AML细胞系中的细胞增殖并触发凋亡。因此，iheyamine A衍生物L42代表了AML治疗的新型候选药物。
